Here we pass-in the excluded fields for the specific "root" model we are querying. The issue is that when you navigate related objects you will need the to resolve excluded fields of related models.

So here we should pass the hole `self.query_tool_models` which maps a model name to its `ModelQueryToolset` class that has get_excluded_fields() method.
